feature_contract.feature_spec: JSON scalar; no classic detection features

label_policy: Only explicitly reviewed intervals supervise negatives; contacts use uncertainty bags; non-replay is inferred only inside reviewed live-contact brackets
split_policy: Underlying match group isolation, including different cleaned frames and replays
limitations: Only two independently sourced underlying matches have reviewed contacts
A third unseen match with frozen independent source labels is required for a final holdout
Neural superiority over classic cannot be claimed from this dataset

videos.annotation_method: Entire source reviewed in chronological one-second contact sheets. Native-frame montages refine the eight omissions and three retained contact brackets. Five source snapshots around each of the 37 old retained contacts confirm genuine departures. Broad overview bounds remain where contact timing is uncertain. This is development footage, not an independent holdout.
limitations: Development footage; failures and predictions informed timing revisions
Many contact brackets are broad overview bounds
Clip preferences came from the classic editor and subsequent visual review

videos.annotation_method: Original-source inspection and native-frame departure checks after targeted gap review. Initial approximate labels sometimes referred to later object-ball movement; their frozen file is retained under before_fix. Brackets cover observed or hidden cue contact, not the later reacquisition estimate. Development intervals, not an independent holdout or whole-video accuracy estimate.
limitations: Only six source intervals are exhaustively contact-labelled
Selected around known failures; unreviewed source remains masked
Clip preferences are lower-weight reviewed classic outputs
